I want to make it clear right away that I won't let this go. I will report it to the appropriate authorities and file a complaint against this clinic. Let me start by saying that I've been trying to make an appointment with a doctor because I've been having health problems for some time now. I have a tightness in my chest, sometimes stabbing, then a severe headache and a feeling like I'm about to vomit. Quite often, I feel a strange feeling of malaise coming on, followed by a stomach ache, then I feel weak and numb, and at the same time, I don't know what I'm doing. I'm losing my bearings.  Back to the point. My daughter called to schedule a doctor's appointment, and every time it's the same. This has been going on for three weeks now. The receptionist decides who will be seen and who won't. During a phone call that was supposed to be an appointment with the doctor, she told my daughter, who was calling because I was at work and couldn't use the phone, to buy some pills at the pharmacy. This call was repeated three times, and it's the same every time. I think this clinic is being arbitrary, ignoring the patient's health. Today, after all this, I was so upset that I lost consciousness. As I wrote, I won't let this go. Someone will answer, especially the receptionist. I'm 59 years old. I've never encountered people like this. I think to be accepted at this facility, you have to be a Pole, a Slovak, or someone else. If you're from a different country, you have no chance of getting help. You pay insurance for nothing.  I'm just waiting for them to tell me to look for another clinic, because that's all they can afford to send such texts. I'll write a complaint about them right away and send it to the appropriate authorities as soon as possible.
